Avoided deforestation.requires: a credible threat to standing forest
Avoided deforestation.provides: large volumes of credits, dependence on a counterfactual baseline

New woodland planting.requires: land available and secured for decades
New woodland planting.provides: measurable growth on the ground, sequestration only over many years

Industrial gas destruction.requires: a plant emitting a high-potency gas
Industrial gas destruction.provides: precise metering at the stack, no land use question at all

Cookstove distribution.provides: many small dispersed reductions, reliance on surveys of usage

Counterfactual scenario modelling.requires: an argued account of what would otherwise happen
Counterfactual scenario modelling.provides: credits for avoided emissions, unverifiable in principle

Direct metering of the flow.requires: an instrument on the emission point
Direct metering of the flow.provides: measurement rather than inference, no scenario argument needed

Sampled household survey.provides: an estimate with confidence bounds, exposure to reporting bias

Remote sensing of land cover.provides: independent observation of change, no insight into causation

Reversal by wildfire.provides: loss of the entire stock in one event, a buffer pool required

Political or tenure change.requires: land rights that can be revoked
Political or tenure change.provides: protection lasting only as long as the regime, no physical guarantee

Permanent chemical destruction.requires: a molecule destroyed rather than stored
Permanent chemical destruction.provides: no possibility of reversal, permanence by physics

Behavioural relapse.requires: users returning to the old practice
Behavioural relapse.provides: reductions ending when the project ends, no lasting asset

Credits issued in full.requires: an auditor satisfied on all counts
Credits issued in full.provides: tradeable units created, revenue to the developer

Volume discounted for uncertainty.provides: fewer credits than claimed, the project still viable

Registration refused.provides: no credits at all, sunk development cost

Credits invalidated after issue.requires: a reversal or an audit failure
